capability: Customer records: the store's customers (Shopify Customers; Salla Customers / العملاء)
note: Parent of CM-CUS-002 to CM-CUS-008. Both platforms give customers a section of their own (Shopify's customers route and Customers section; Salla's Customers link, its All customers and Customer settings links, its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-customers and its Merchant API folder Customers). Their sub-parts that have a place of their own on at least one platform are children; customer tags, custom fields and metadata, sorting and customer approval stay here, since neither platform gives them a section, route, API group, plan line or app category of their own.

capability: Customer segments and customer groups (Shopify Segments, customer saved searches; Salla Customer groups / تصنيف العملاء إلى مجموعات)
note: Q1's M-019. Shopify's route puts segments in its Customers section (path segments) and Salla's link puts Customer groups in the customers list (/customers/groups). Shopify's webhook topics keep the name customer_groups for a customer saved search. Salla's automatic classification (تصنيف تلقائي لمجموعات العملاء), a plan line of its own, is kept here: its description classifies customers by properties such as their number of orders, which is the grouping this capability is, not another thing.

capability: Bulk actions on customers (Shopify customer bulk edit; Salla customers-bulk-actions, إدارة مجموعة عملاء كدفعة واحدة)
note: Shopify gives it an admin route (customer:bulk-edit, path bulk/customer) and Salla a plan line and a released flag. What actions either platform includes isn't stated.

capability: Merging customer records (Shopify customer merge)
note: Shopify gives it an admin route (customer:merge), a staff permission (MERGE_CUSTOMERS), access scopes and a webhook topic (customers/merge: "Triggers when two customers are merged").

capability: Blocking customers (Salla حظر العميل, customer_block)
note: Salla gives it a plan line and a staff permission. What a blocked customer can't do isn't stated. Shopify's customers/disable and customers/enable webhook topics are undefined in the concern map and aren't joined here; they stay in CM-CUS-001.

capability: Flagging non-serious customers (Salla كشف العملاء غير الجادين, the tag عميل غير جاد)
note: Salla gives it a plan line in its customers group. Its definition is a statement of Salla's fraud-protection concern (SA-C-122, domain C), cited as shows.

capability: Customers' marketing consent: email, SMS and WhatsApp (Shopify marketing status and marketing consent)
note: Shopify's route puts it in its Customers section (path :id/marketing, Edit marketing status). Not the consent to tracking and cookies, which is privacy (SH-C-148, domain A), nor the merchant's responsibility for consents under Shopify Pixel Manager (SH-S-0067), which is the pixels capability's.

capability: Customer addresses (Salla Shipping addresses settings, national address / العنوان الوطني; Shopify customer addresses)
note: Parent of CM-CUS-009. Salla's settings route puts it with its other customers settings (customers/address). Not the order's shipping address (order.shipping.address.updated), which is the order's.

capability: Map and location services for addresses (Salla Geolocation / الموقع الجغرافي apps; google-maps-service, here-service, location-i-q-service)
note: Salla gives it an app category of its own. Homonym kept apart: Shopify's Geolocation apps (SH-C-111, domain E) is visitor geolocation, matched in Q1 with WooCommerce's (M-087); U-079 is ruled apart. What Salla's map services locate isn't stated beyond its category's title تحديد دقيق للمواقع (Accurate positioning).

capability: Customer accounts: the buyer's sign-in and registration in the store (Shopify Customer accounts; Salla Login & registration options / customer login)
note: Parent of CM-CUS-011 to CM-CUS-014. A join on role (see notes). Shopify puts customer accounts in Settings and its own admin section CustomerAccounts, apart from Customers; Salla puts its Login & registration options among its customers settings (customers/login_methods). The platforms' groupings differ, so it has no parent: the anchor platforms' admin groupings don't share one.

capability: Third-party identity providers and single sign-on for buyers (Shopify Third-party identity providers, Multipass; Salla sso-login)
note: Shopify's routes put it in its CustomerAccounts section (identity_providers, authentication). Salla shows only a flag that isn't released, sso-login: that it is the buyer's sign-in is a reading, from Q1 placing it in Salla's customer login concern.

capability: reCAPTCHA verification at buyers' sign-in and registration (Salla reCAPTCHA verification)
note: Salla gives it a settings route of its own (customers/recaptcha). Homonym kept apart: Shopify's Bot protection (SH-C-051, domain A) blocks bots from checkout, not sign-in.

capability: WhatsApp verification codes for buyers (Salla WhatsApp verification)
note: Salla gives it a settings route of its own (customers/whatsapp_otp). Not WhatsApp marketing consent (CM-CUS-007), nor Shopify's merchant sign-up with WhatsApp.

capability: Customer account UI extensions: apps' pages and blocks in the buyer's account (Shopify Customer account UI)
note: Shopify gives it an extension type of its own (customer_account_ui) and its targets (customer-account.*). The extension target is the channel; the capability is what the buyer's account shows, so it is CUS's (scope.tsv).

capability: Discounts: the store's price reductions for buyers (Shopify Discounts; Salla offers and discounts / عروض وخصومات)
note: Parent of CM-MKT-002 to CM-MKT-004. Shopify gives discounts a section of its own (route discounts, the section Discounts, the API group Discounts and marketing, the webhook topics discounts/*). Salla has no single discounts section: its Marketing links put Coupons (/marketing/coupons) and Promotional Offers (/marketing/offers) side by side, its settings route Offer priority (coupons/discount-priorities) orders discounts among themselves, and its plan line إطلاق عروض وخصومات names offers and discounts together. The parent is a reading: Shopify's Discounts holds its discount codes (plan line Create and share discount codes); Salla's coupons, special offers and bank offers (عروض البنك, "نوع خصم جديد", SA-S-5028) are each a kind of discount. Batch 3 lands Salla's concerns.

capability: Discount codes and coupons: a code the buyer enters (Shopify discount codes, redeem codes; Salla Coupons / كوبونات التخفيض)
note: Shopify's plan line Create and share discount codes, its store entitlement discountCodes and its webhook topics discounts/redeemcode_added and discounts/redeemcode_removed; Salla's link Coupons, dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-coupons, API folder Coupons, plan line كوبونات التخفيض and event coupon.applied. Q1's U-058 asks whether Shopify's discount codes and Salla's coupons are one thing: batch 3 rules on it.

capability: Automatic discounts and special offers: applied without a code (Salla Special Offers, Promotional Offers / العروض الخاصة)
note: Salla gives it a place of its own: the link Promotional Offers (/marketing/offers), the API folder Special Offers, the plan line العروض الخاصة and the webhook topics specialoffer.*; its plan line إطلاق عروض وخصومات says the offers "تُطبق تلقائيًا عند الطلب". No Shopify statement held names automatic discounts. Q1's U-057 (Salla Special Offers against Shopify Discounts and Promotion apps) is batch 3's to rule.

capability: Discount functions: apps' custom discount logic run by the platform (Shopify Discount Function API, Discounts allocator)
note: Shopify's own extension type: the Function API targets Discount and Discounts allocator and the admin target discount_details_function_settings. Homonym: Salla's App Functions (serverless functions run on store events, SA-C-196, domain F) are not discount logic; Salla's cell is none-held.

capability: Marketing campaigns and marketing activities (Shopify Growth, Campaigns, Marketing; Salla Marketing, Campaigns / الحملات التسويقية)
note: Q1's M-051 (SH-C-129 with SA-C-075; WooCommerce's WC-C-084 and WC-C-110 for its own part). Parent of CM-MKT-006 and CM-MKT-007. Shopify's routes growth and marketing, its Growth and Campaigns sections and marketing-event scopes; Salla's Campaigns link (/marketing/campaign/retargeting), its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-marketing-campaign and its campaign permissions. Shopify's plan line Capture customer leads (SH-I-1187) is placed here and is not defined in any held statement, so it isn't a capability of its own.

capability: Marketing automations (Shopify Create marketing automations, Autopilot)
note: Shopify's plan line Create marketing automations and its Growth entry Autopilot; Shopify's staff permission puts automations under Marketing (Marketing > View, create, and delete marketing activities and automations, SH-I-0936), the parent. What an automation does is not defined in any held statement.

capability: Email and SMS marketing campaigns (Shopify Messaging: Shopify Email, SMS campaigns; Salla حملات تسويقية عبر الرسائل النصية وإشعارات التطبيق)
note: Shopify's route email/create and its plan lines Create email campaigns and Pay-per-send SMS campaigns; Salla's plan line for marketing campaigns by SMS and app notifications and the event marketing.campaign.broadcast. Both name them campaigns, which puts them under CM-MKT-005: a reading. Q1's M-052 joins Shopify's to WooCommerce's MailPoet, for its part.

capability: Sales attribution: crediting orders to marketing (Shopify Attribution, order attribution config)
note: Shopify's Growth entry Attribution, its conversion summary route gated by MARKETING_SECTION and its extension target order_attribution_config. Q1's M-053 joins it to WooCommerce's Order Attribution. No parent: no held statement puts Attribution under Shopify's Campaigns.

capability: Customer events and tracking pixels (Shopify Customer events, web pixels, Shopify Pixel Manager; Salla Pixels & feeds, Ecommerce Events)
note: Q1's M-055, a difference of grain: Shopify splits product feeds (SH-C-138, domain E) from customer events and pixels (SH-C-146); Salla splits pixels and feeds (SA-C-074) from storefront e-commerce events (SA-C-092). This capability takes the events and pixels; product feeds stay with domain E. The event names are one identifier family (checkout_started / Checkout Started, cart_viewed / Cart Viewed).

capability: Advertising on ad platforms (Shopify Advertising apps; Salla Ads / إعلانات سلة, الربط مع الخدمات الإعلانية)
note: Parent of CM-MKT-011. Shopify's App Store category Advertising apps; Salla's link Salla Ads (/marketing/ads/dashboard), "Salla's product for simplifying the creation, management, and analysis of digital advertising campaigns" (SA-S-0007), its plan line إعلانات سلة and its plan line for linking the store with ad services (Google Ads, Snapchat, TikTok and others). Q1's U-055 is batch 3's to rule.

capability: Audiences for advertising (Shopify Audiences; Salla Ads audiences / الجماهير)
note: Shopify Audiences "helps you to find new customers by generating custom audiences for advertising platforms" (SH-S-0734). Salla's audience manager is a route of Salla Ads (/marketing/ads/(tools|audience-manager)) with its own permissions (استعراض الجماهير, إدارة الجماهير), which puts it under CM-MKT-010; no held statement defines Salla's audiences, so the join rests on the term inside advertising: a reading, and a weak one.

capability: Shop Campaigns: the platform's own ads program, paid per conversion (Shopify Shop Campaigns)
note: Shopify's plan line Acquire customers risk-free with Shop Campaigns and its own Shop Campaigns Merchant Terms: "an ads program ... You're charged only when a customer converts" (SH-S-0726), running "across the Shop app, Shop website, Shopify Product Network, and optional third-party placements" (SH-S-7252). Shopify's help puts it under the Shop sales channel (SH-C-136, domain E), not under advertising apps, so it has no parent.

capability: Affiliate and creator marketing (Shopify Collabs; Salla affiliate marketing and influencers, @salla.sa/ui-merchant-partner-marketing)
note: Parent of CM-MKT-014 and CM-MKT-015. Salla's dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-partner-marketing holds marketing/referrals, marketing/affiliates, experts, influencers and marketplace in one (SA-S-3550); Shopify Collabs "helps businesses and creators connect using a marketplace-style app" and lets businesses "track affiliate sales, and send payments to their affiliates" (SH-S-0731, SH-S-0732). Q1's U-056.

capability: Affiliate marketing run by the store (Shopify Affiliate program apps, Collabs affiliates; Salla Affiliate marketing / التسويق بالعمولة)
note: Salla's link Affiliate marketing (/marketing/affiliate), API folder Affiliates, plan line التسويق بالعمولة and its affiliate settings routes (coupons/commission-period and others); Shopify's App Store category Affiliate program apps and Collabs' affiliate sales.

capability: Creator and influencer marketing (Shopify Collabs creators; Salla Influencers / التسويق مع المؤثرين)
note: Salla's link Influencers (/marketing/influencers), plan line التسويق مع المؤثرين, its influencer permissions and the released flag influencer-marketplace, with influencers' own pages in Salla's Partners portal (SA-C-206, domain F); Shopify Collabs, which connects businesses and creators.

capability: Back-in-stock alerts: buyers notified when a product is available again (Salla Back in stock alerts / أعلمني عند التوفر; Shopify Stock alert apps)
note: Salla gives it a settings route of its own (products/notify_availability, SA-S-1754) and a webhook event (product.availability.alert, SA-S-1666); Shopify an App Store category of its own (Stock alert apps, SH-I-1844, an inventory entry of SH-C-188, domain B, which names D under also). Q1's M-080 joins Salla's concern with WooCommerce's Back in Stock Notifications (WC-C-069). Salla's concern also holds wishlist notifications, which have a settings route of their own and are CM-MKT-017.

capability: Wishlist notifications: buyers notified about products they saved (Salla Wishlist Notifications)
note: Salla's settings route products/wishlist-notifications (SA-S-1761) and its released flag wishlist-notifications (SA-S-3173). No statement held defines what the notification says or when it is sent. The wishlist itself (Salla's Wishlist API, SA-C-091; Shopify's Wishlist apps, SH-C-187) isn't this capability: it is for the batch that lands SH-C-187 (LOY) and for domain E. Parent CM-LOY-005, wishlists (the coordinator, after batch 4: Salla's Wishlist Notifications, SA-S-1761, is cited in both).

capability: Bank offers: a discount applied when the buyer pays with a given bank's card (Salla عروض البنك / عروض وخصومات البنك)
note: Salla's plan line عروض البنك (SA-S-2110) and its released flags bank-offer and bank-offer-scope; its definition, "هو نوع خصم جديد يُطبق عندما يدفع العميل قيمة الطلب من خلال بطاقة بنك محدد" (SA-S-5028). Parent CM-MKT-003 by Salla's grouping: one dashboard app, @salla.sa/ui-merchant-offers, holds /marketing/offers, conditional, banks and cashback (SA-S-3589). The coupon restricted to a payment method (flag coupon-payment-method, SA-S-3252) is a coupon condition, cited in CM-MKT-002.

capability: Marketing calendar (Salla Marketing calendar / الجدول الزمني للتسويق)
note: Salla's link Marketing calendar (/marketing/calendar, SA-S-1819) in its Marketing list, its plan line الجدول الزمني للتسويق (SA-S-2013) and the released flag marketing-calendar (SA-S-3254). No statement held says what the calendar holds. Parent CM-MKT-005: SA-C-075 holds campaigns and the calendar together, and both links are in Salla's marketing list of links (list 3, SA-S-1818 and SA-S-1819), which holds every marketing link, so the list alone doesn't make the calendar a part of campaigns; a reading.

capability: Ads wallet: the balance ad spend is paid from (Salla Ads wallet and payment / محفظة الإعلانات)
note: Salla's staff permissions salla_ads_wallet_browse and salla_ads_wallet_management (SA-S-2381, SA-S-2382) and its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-ads-payment (/marketing/ads/payment, SA-S-3600), inside Salla Ads; its help says amounts are deducted from the wallet (SA-S-5134), and on Meta the wallet is Sweply's (SA-S-5135). Salla's marketing credits (xio) aren't defined and stay in CM-MKT-010.

capability: Upsell and cross-sell offers (Shopify Upsell and cross-sell apps; Salla Cross/up sell)
note: An App Store category on both: Shopify's Upsell and cross-sell apps (SH-I-1846, an inventory entry of SH-C-188, domain B, which names D under also) under Upsell and bundle apps; Salla's Cross/up sell (SA-S-1188), an app category in its extension-points list, which Q1 placed in its special offers concern. Neither platform defines it beyond the category's name. Product bundles, the other half of Shopify's Upsell and bundle apps, are domain B's CM-SEL-006.

capability: Store credit and customer wallet: a balance the store holds for a buyer (Shopify Store credit; Salla Customer wallet / محفظة العميل)
note: Parent of CM-LOY-002 (gift cards) and CM-LOY-003 (cashback). Shopify gives store credit routes of its own in its Customers section (store_credit_account, SH-S-7085, SH-S-7086) and access scopes; Salla gives its customer wallet a link (/wallet), a dashboard app, a Merchant API folder, an access scope and an event. Joined on role, a reading: both are a buyer's balance the store adds to and the buyer pays with. Homonyms kept apart: Salla's store wallet (Wallet, /payments/wallet, SA-C-005, Salla's billing of the merchant), Salla's ads wallet (CM-MKT-020) and Shopify Balance (SH-C-088) are the merchant's money, not a buyer's.

capability: Gift cards (Shopify Gift cards; Salla Gift cards / wallet/gift-card)
note: Q1's M-013. Shopify gives gift cards an admin section of its own (gift_cards) and a plan line; Salla puts them in its customer wallet's settings (wallet/gift-card, SA-S-1767). The parent follows Salla's grouping and the one both platforms state: Shopify's Gift Card and Store Credit Terms govern gift cards and store credit together (SH-S-0676, SH-S-0677), and Shopify's admin keeps gift cards apart from store credit. A reading. Homonym: gift cards (stored value) aren't gifting (CM-LOY-006); Shopify's App Store categories Gift apps and Gifts - Other (SH-I-1822, SH-I-1825) are named only, and aren't cited in either.

capability: Cashback offers: rewards credited to the buyer's wallet (Salla Cashback / عروض الكاش باك)
note: Salla's plan line عروض الكاش باك, its settings route coupons/cashback-eligibility and its offers dashboard app's path /marketing/cashback. Parent CM-LOY-001 because Salla credits cashback to the customer's wallet and takes it back from there (SA-S-5019), and its wallet settings hold Wallet & Cashback Notifications (SA-S-1768); its offers dashboard app also holds cashback beside offers and bank offers (SA-S-3589, CM-MKT-003 and CM-MKT-018), a grouping not followed here. A reading. Homonym: the cash back of Shopify Credit's card (SH-C-090, domain C) is the merchant's card reward.

capability: Loyalty programmes and rewards (Shopify Customer loyalty apps, Loyalty and reward apps; Salla Loyalty program / برنامج الولاء, Loyalty Points)
note: Q1's M-075. Shopify gives it App Store categories (Customer loyalty apps, Loyalty and reward apps); Salla a link, a dashboard app, settings routes, Merchant API folders and a plan line. Salla's settings routes Program details, Points settings, Rewards banner and Markets configure the one programme and stay here. Shopify's Shop Cash, a Shopify-funded rewards programme for Shop app customers (SH-S-0437), is cited here as the only Shopify statement of a rewards programme: a strained fit, since it is Shopify's programme across the Shop app, not the store's. Homonym: Salla's مكافأة الراجحي (SA-C-119, a payment method, domain C) isn't a store's reward.

capability: Wishlists: products a buyer saves (Shopify Wishlist apps; Salla Wishlist)
note: Shopify's App Store category Wishlist apps (SH-I-1821, in SH-C-187); Salla's Wishlist API folder in its Twilight SDK (SA-S-1140, SA-C-091, domain E), its wishlist events (SA-C-092) and its settings route Wishlist Notifications (SA-S-1761). Neither platform defines the wishlist beyond Salla's events (a customer adds a product to the wishlist). Salla's wishlist notifications are CM-MKT-017; a reviewer may make it a child of this capability. Domain E's model may hold the storefront's wishlist through SA-C-091.

capability: Gifting: buying a product for someone else, with its message and card (Salla Gifting / نظام الإهداء; Shopify Gift wrap and message apps)
note: Salla gives it a link (/gift-system, /marketing/gift), a dashboard app, settings routes (Selected markets, Product type customization, Messages & cards customization), a staff permission and a released flag buy-as-gift; Shopify an App Store category, Gift wrap and message apps (SH-I-1824, an inventory entry of SH-C-189, domain B, which doesn't name D under also: cited from another domain, see the cell). A join on role, a reading, resting on Salla's gift order (SA-S-1663) and messages and cards against the category's name; Shopify doesn't define it.

capability: Reorder reminders: reminding a buyer to buy a product again (Salla Reorder Reminder / تذكيرات إعادة الشراء)
note: Salla's link Reorder Reminder (/marketing/reorder-reminders), its staff permissions, its released flag reorder-reminders and its communication-app event customer.repurchase.reminder. Shopify's cell is none-held. Homonyms: Salla's Reorder setting (orders/reorder, SA-C-040, domain C) is a buyer reordering a past order, not a reminder; Shopify's Payment reminder template (SH-I-2027) is about payment.

capability: Reviews and ratings, with product questions (Shopify Product reviews / Product review apps; Salla Reviews & questions / الأسئلة والتقييمات)
note: Shopify's App Store category Product review apps (SH-S-2601) and the Shop app's product reviews (SH-S-7476); Salla's link Reviews & questions (/feedback), its settings routes, plan lines, staff permissions, flags, API folders Reviews and Feedbacks, access scope reviews and webhook review.added. Salla's concern also holds product questions (questions_management), which have only permissions and a shared plan line, so they stay here (Q1's M-065 granularity note). Homonym: Shopify's admin section Reviews (SH-I-0832, which Q1 placed in SH-C-154) holds the routes of the fraud protection terms (SH-S-7109, SH-S-7110, SH-C-073, domain A), not product reviews; it isn't cited here.

capability: Review requests: asking the buyer to rate (Salla Review requests / إرسال رابط التقييم للعميل)
note: Salla's settings route feedback/rating_message (Review requests) under its feedback settings, its plan line إرسال رابط التقييم للعميل (plan سلة برو) and its released flags customer-send-rating and order-send-rating. Shopify's cell is none-held: its Product review apps (CM-SUP-001) don't say whether they request reviews.

capability: Social proof and social trust (Shopify Social proof apps; Social trust apps)
note: Shopify's App Store categories Social trust apps, Social proof apps and Social trust - Other (SH-I-1836, SH-I-1838, SH-I-1839, entries Q1 placed in SH-C-154). No statement defines them, or shows that Product review apps sit under Social trust, so CM-SUP-001 has no parent. Salla's cell is none-held; its storefront component salla-trust-badges (SA-C-091, domain E) isn't defined and isn't cited.

capability: Chat with customers (Shopify Inbox / Chat with customers; Salla Chat / salla_chat)
note: Q1's M-064. Shopify's plan line Chat with customers and its Shopify Inbox app; Salla's link Salla Chat (/channel/chat), its dashboard apps and released flag salla_chat. Shopify's App Store category Chat apps (SH-I-1958, SH-C-192) is cited here as the apps' interface. Homonyms: Shopify's admin section MobileChat (SH-I-0821, placed by Q1 in SH-C-153) begins with the route sidekick:mobile, Shopify's assistant, and isn't cited; Shopify's 24/7 support by live chat (SH-S-7015, SH-C-155) is Shopify's support to merchants; Sell in AI chats (SH-S-7007, SH-C-140) is a sales channel.

capability: Customer support and help desk tickets (Shopify Support apps / Helpdesk apps; Salla Self-service system / نظام التذاكر)
note: Shopify's App Store categories Support apps, Helpdesk apps and Support - Other; Salla's link Self-service system (/tickets), its dashboard app ui-merchant-ticketing-system and its plan line نظام التذاكر, "يتيح للعميل رفع تذكرة أو متابعة حالة الطلب" (SA-S-2095). A join on role, a reading (U-041): Shopify defines neither category. Shopify's sibling categories Chat apps, FAQ apps and Survey apps are cited in CM-SUP-004, 006 and 007.

capability: FAQ (Shopify FAQ apps)
note: Shopify's App Store category FAQ apps (SH-S-2723), not defined. Salla's cell is none-held: the matches are the FAQ headings of Salla's own help pages. Salla's product questions (questions_management) are buyers' questions on a product, cited in CM-SUP-001, not a store's FAQ.

capability: Customer surveys (Shopify Survey apps)
note: Shopify's App Store category Survey apps (SH-I-1962, an entry of SH-C-192), not defined. Salla's cell is none-held; its report report_customer_satisfaction (CM-ANL-002) is a report, not a survey.

capability: Customer complaints about the store (Salla Complaints / إدارة الشكاوى)
note: Salla's link Complaints (/manage/complaints), its staff permission complaint_management and its email on a new complaint on the store (SA-S-5089). Salla's complaints platform, where the customer opens the complaint and Salla mediates (منصة الشكاوى, SA-C-178, domain A, which doesn't name D), isn't cited. Homonyms: Shopify's internal complaint-handling system and P2B and financial complaints (SH-C-177, SH-C-178, domain A) are merchants' complaints to Shopify; Salla's quality gateway (بوابة الجودة, SA-C-150, domain C) is the merchant's complaints about shipping companies; Shopify's disputes are payment chargebacks.

capability: Analytics and reports (Shopify Analytics; Salla Reports, Analytics / التقارير والتحليلات)
note: Q1's M-058. Shopify's admin route analytics, its navigation item, staff permissions, plan line and Admin API resource Analytics; Salla's dashboard app for /reports/analysis, its plan lines for analytics (sales, customers, visits, profits) and its app category Analytics (التحليل و الاحصاء). Children: reports (002), overview dashboards (003), Live View (004), smart analytics (005), and analytics through the API for apps (006).

capability: Reports (Shopify Reports; Salla Reports / التقارير)
note: Shopify's route analytics:reports, gated by the REPORTS permission (Analytics > Reports); Salla's link Reports (/reports), its dashboard app for its report pages, its settings route Statuses included in reports, its plan lines for reports and its staff permissions for each report. Salla's report types (sales, orders, customers, visits, loyalty, wishlists and others) are kinds of report, with permissions only, so they stay here. Shopify's plan line "200+ real-time reports, plus custom analytics" is cited in the parent.

capability: Overview dashboards and store performance (Shopify Overviews, Home; Salla Store performance / ملخص أداء المتجر)
note: Shopify's route analytics:overview gated by OVERVIEWS, and its staff permissions Analytics > Overviews, Home > Home and DASHBOARD; Salla's link Store performance (/reports/performance), its plan lines ملخص أداء المتجر and أداء المتجر, and its staff permissions for the home page's month and orders summaries and alerts. A join on role, a reading: neither platform defines an overview beyond its names.

capability: Live View (Shopify Live View)
note: Shopify's route analytics:live, gated by the store entitlement storefront, and its navigation item Live View. No statement defines it. Salla's cell is none-held.
